F1.6.description: Our free taster lesson. You'll learn how to hold your clippers and comb the way working barbers do, then watch a full, clean taper from start to finish on a real client. No experience needed.
learn: The two grips you'll use on almost every cut
How to keep the comb and clipper working together
Where a taper starts and how to blend it
Cleaning up the neckline and around the ears

B5.1.description: Everything starts with how you hold your tools. A good grip keeps your lines straight, saves your wrist, and makes every other lesson easier. We break down the clipper and comb grips we use every day at Society Barbers.
learn: Where your thumb and fingers sit on the comb
How to switch between tools without fumbling
Common grip mistakes and how to fix them

B9.1.description: Your first full haircut, filmed start to finish. We walk through a clean, classic taper on a real client, explaining every guard change and every pass.
learn: Consultation and setting up the chair
Blending with guards and the lever
Finishing the top and the neckline

I1.3.description: The low skin fade is the cut clients ask for most. We show how to set the line low, take it to skin, and blend it so there are no dark lines, step by step on a real client.
learn: Placing a low guide line that suits the head shape
Taking the bottom to skin with a foil shaver
Blending with the lever and open guard
